bugs.creator: michaelchirico4
bugs.summary: Mismatched standard package & R version requirements should be an error

comments.creator: michaelchirico4
comments.text:
I just tried installing a package (coneproj) with this in DESCRIPTION

```
Depends: R(>= 4.4.0)
Imports: Rcpp (>= 0.10.4), methods (>= 4.5.0)
```

When run from R 4.4.0, installation fail like so:

```
install.packages("coneproj")
# Warning: dependency ‘methods’ is not available
# <does full compilation of src/ code>
# more output
# ** byte-compile and prepare package for lazy loading
# Error in loadNamespace(j <- i[[1L]], c(lib.loc, .libPaths()), versionCheck = vI[[j]]) : 
#   namespace ‘methods’ 4.4.0 is already loaded, but >= 4.5.0 is required
# Calls: <Anonymous> ... namespaceImportFrom -> asNamespace -> loadNamespace
# Execution halted
# ERROR: lazy loading failed for package ‘coneproj’
# * removing ‘/media/michael/69913553-793b-4435-ac82-0e7df8e34b9f/tmpCRAN/coneproj’
```

This seems like a waste of time. I can't think of a reason to put a version requirement on a standard package in `Depends`, `Imports`, or `LinkingTo`. Even doing so once when they all agree risks them drifting apart over time. Conceivably there could be a use for doing so on weaker dependencies like `Suggests`.

I think it's preferable to require standardization to version requirements on `R` alone, but certainly any requirements among hard dependencies on standard packages must agree.

I find 246 packages on CRAN with such mismatching version requirements on standard packages, including Arothron which has 5 distinct version requirements:

https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/Arothron/index.html

```
db = data.frame(available.packages())

default_packages <- tools:::.get_standard_package_names()$base

for (dep in c("Depends", "Imports", "LinkingTo"))
  db[[dep]] = lapply(db[[dep]], \(x) if (!is.na(x)) tools:::.split_dependencies(x))
db$hard_deps <- lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(db)),
  \(i) c(db$Depends[[i]], db$Imports[[i]], db$LinkingTo[[i]])
)
db$default_deps <- lapply(
  db$hard_deps,
  \(x) x[names(x) %in% c("R", default_packages)]
)
db$default_deps_versions <- lapply(
  db$default_deps,
  \(x) Filter(length, lapply(x, \(xi) xi$version))
)
db$n_distinct_default_deps_versions <- vapply(
  db$default_deps_versions,
  \(x) length(unique(unlist(x, recursive=FALSE))),
  integer(1L)
)
table(db$n_distinct_default_deps_versions)
#     0     1     2     3     5 
#  7125 15631   228    17     1 
```
